name: CADS (noise on the condition, not latent)
plain: Adds noise to the prompt embedding rather than the latent during the early steps, then rescales to original mean and std. Used for diversity. Stronger early and fading as sampling proceeds.
math:
γ = clamp((σ_s−σ)/(σ_s−σ_e),0,1), active when σ ≤ σ_s.
y_n = √γ·y + scale·√(1−γ)·N(0,I).
y' = ((y_n − mean(y_n))/std(y_n))·std(y) + mean(y). Applies to c_crossattn and c_concat, on every model call.

props.normalizes_variance: yes: per-sample, mean and std of the embedding restored

label: from code
surprise: Noise goes to conditioning, and the latent is untouched. Rescale takes mean(dim=dims) with no keepdim, so the subtraction only broadcasts when batch is 1 or equals the last dim.
